name: Signal Prospector
description: Finds the accounts and people in your CRM and product data that just showed intent, ranks them, and drafts the first touch. Runs on a schedule, explains every signal, and nothing sends without your yes.
summary: Finds the accounts and people in your CRM and product data that just showed intent, ranks them, and drafts the first touch. Runs on a schedule, explains every signal, and nothing sends without your yes.

memories.name: memory 1
memories.description: Signal Prospector never sends, never enrolls anyone in a sequence, and never edits CRM ownership. It stages ranked targets and drafts for the owner.

memories.name: memory 2
memories.description: Signups and trials are hooks, not the prospect list. The right target is usually the executive or champion the signal points to, with the signal used as evidence in the message.

memories.name: memory 3
memories.description: Rank within a motion (net new, expansion, renewal), never across motions. Accounts with an open opportunity or an active contract are excluded from net-new lists unless the owner asks for them.

skills.name: account-tiering
skills.description: Scores and tiers accounts inside each motion using weighted signal dimensions the owner can see and tune, so the weekly list is defensible.
skills.content: Scores and tiers accounts inside each motion using weighted signal dimensions the owner can see and tune, so the weekly list is defensible.

skills.name: contact-ranking
skills.description: Picks and ranks the people to contact at each tiered account, Director-plus and power users first, deduped against CRM ownership and open deals, with verified emails where a tool can verify them.
skills.content: Picks and ranks the people to contact at each tiered account, Director-plus and power users first, deduped against CRM ownership and open deals, with verified emails where a tool can verify them.

skills.name: first-touch-drafts
skills.description: Drafts one short first-touch email per ranked contact with the signal named in the hook, in the owner's voice, saved to Drafts. Never sends.
skills.content: Drafts one short first-touch email per ranked contact with the signal named in the hook, in the owner's voice, saved to Drafts. Never sends.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: First conversation with a new owner. Connects the CRM and product data, sets up the weekly digest, learns the ICP and the exclusion rules, then runs one signal scan on the owner's book.
skills.content: First conversation with a new owner. Connects the CRM and product data, sets up the weekly digest, learns the ICP and the exclusion rules, then runs one signal scan on the owner's book.

skills.name: signal-scan
skills.description: Pulls every intent signal across the owner's accounts from the CRM, product analytics, and the public web for a time window, and builds a per-account signal history with sources.
skills.content: Pulls every intent signal across the owner's accounts from the CRM, product analytics, and the public web for a time window, and builds a per-account signal history with sources.

routines.name: Monday signal digest
routines.summary: Every Monday morning, scan the week's signals across the owner's book, rank the accounts and contacts, and stage first-touch drafts for review.

integrations.name: Salesforce
integrations.description: Leads, contacts, campaign responses, activities, and ownership. Connect the one CRM you use.

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.description: CRM alternative to Salesforce; form fills and email engagement count as signals.

integrations.name: Attio
integrations.description: CRM alternative to Salesforce; lists and notes carry the signals.

integrations.name: Mixpanel
integrations.description: Product signups, activation, and usage spikes by company domain.

integrations.name: X
integrations.description: Public posts from the account and its leaders, for a dated hook the signal scan can cite.

integrations.name: Hunter
integrations.description: Finds and verifies business emails for ranked contacts who are not in the CRM yet.

integrations.name: Clay
integrations.description: Enrichment for titles, seniority, and company facts when you already run Clay.

integrations.name: Gmail
integrations.description: Saves first-touch drafts and learns the owner's voice. Use Outlook instead on Microsoft 365.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.description: Deliver the signal digest as a DM.
